papers.title_en: Gen Through the Lens: Camera-Controllable Video Generation via Cross-Coordinate Conditioning Fusion
papers.authors: Shuai Li, Jinxu Xiang, Xinyuan Li, Hanlei Guo, Xiyang Tan, Alan Zhao, Xiaotong Zhao, Ran Zhang
papers.evidence: 结合空间几何提示的相机可控视频生成
papers.tldr: 现有相机可控视频生成多将相机运动视为抽象条件或依赖单一坐标系，难以兼顾真实感与物理一致性。本文提出Gen Through the Lens，将控制信号分解到相机、世界与物体三个坐标空间，并通过跨坐标条件融合统一引导生成。实验表明，该方法在多种相机操作下实现可控且视觉一致的结果，在真实感与可编辑性上优于现有方法，为精细相机控制提供新方案。
papers.abstract_en: We present Gen Through the Lens, a camera-controllable image-to-video generation framework that synthesizes videos from a given reference image while enabling realistic and physically consistent camera operations. Unlike previous models that treat camera motion as abstract conditioning or rely on a single coordinate system, our approach explicitly decomposes and fuses control signals across three coordinate spaces: the camera coordinate (modeled by intrinsic parameters), the world coordinate (represented by spatial geometry hints), and the object coordinate (described by 3D bounding boxes of target subjects). Through cross-coordinate conditioning fusion, these heterogeneous cues are unified to guide the generative process, enabling precise control of camera motion, focus, and framing while preserving temporal and spatial coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces controllable and visually consistent results across diverse camera operations, outperforming existing approaches in both realism and editability.
